title: Guacamole
ingredients: 1 tbsp jalapeño peppers from a jar, drained and finely chopped
method: In a medium bowl, mix the coriander, garlic and jalapeños with the lime juice.
Peel, stone and roughly mash the avocados with a potato masher.
Add them to the bowl with the other ingredients and some seasoning.
Serve with the fajitas or with some tortilla chips to start.
